answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33415 Country: Bangladesh Title: salah behind imam saying Ya nabi salamualika Question: In my office area all of the Imam who like to do qiyam and Ya Nabi Salamu Alaika, specially they do not like Tabligh Jamat. I do not like to follow them. Is our salah acceptable behind this Imam? And now I arrange a Jamah in my office with some of my colleagues. Did we do right or wrong? Answer ID: 33415 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1227/1227/M=1432) If the Imams who do Qiyam and salam have shirkiya beliefs then salah is not right behind them, and if they do not have shirkiya beliefs, rather they are involved only in bid’ah and superstitions then by offering salah behind them one can get the reward of jama’ah. You are right to do jama’ah with your colleagues. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
